innovation_summary: Private Python repository framed as an APEX legal-intelligence engine for tracking, analyzing, and strategically mapping xAI and Elon Musk litigation. Two independent monolith registries flag it rather than endorse it: the xAI canonicalization pass dispositions it REASSIGN_AWAY_FROM_COLOSSUS_INFRASTRUCTURE (it does not belong in the compute-infrastructure story), and the legal source-inspection registry lists it in name_only_backlog, meaning no commit or content inspection has ever been performed. Wave-3 mining confirmed the catalog desc, the name_only_backlog status, the reassignment disposition, the templated capabilities entry, and the 'real-time' truth-boundary flag. Its 'real-time' framing is unsupported by any local evidence; rating raised only to 3 (catalog desc + recorded dispositions, still unverified and un-inspected) and cannot exceed 5 without source-level inspection and a provenance/citation receipt.
